column1: # Russian surah names and meanings, as the site's own index page lists them:
# "Meaning (Name)" per surah, all 114 on one page, so this cost one request.
# Taken VERBATIM, defects included -- the corrections live in
# scraper/ru_surah_names.py:_OVERRIDES, where each one names what is wrong.
# Two things are wrong at source, and both are invisible to a reader:
#   31  the name is written "Луман", one letter short of Лукман, and its
#       meaning carries a LATIN "a" inside an otherwise Cyrillic word.
#   106 the name carries a LATIN "p" and "a" -- "Куpaйш" does not match
#       "Курайш" on any comparison, so the picker would never find it.
# The site also numbers al-Alaq 95, which is at-Tin's number; its list is in
# the right ORDER, so the id below is the row's position, not the site's
# printed number. Every row was cross-checked against surahs.name_translation
